Complete Financials Results For Year Ended 31 March, 2026.

analysis.summary: Sparkle Gold Rock Limited (formerly Sree Jayalakshmi Autospin Limited) presented its 34th Annual Report for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, detailing operations, financial results, and corporate governance matters. During the year, the company altered its name, increased its authorized share capital, and expanded its business objectives to include mining, trading in precious metals, bullion, and jewellery. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 900.03 lakhs and a net loss after tax of Rs. 24.50 lakhs for the financial year 2024-2025.

demand_outlook.quote: Your Company believes that demand conditions in the real estate sector are exhibiting early signs of improvement, and signs of declining interest rates as well as renewed activity in the lending and public capital markets are expected to ease funding pressures.
